# Voltip

> Voltip is an open-source voice typing and dictation app for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. Hold a shortcut, speak and release: the speech-to-text result is inserted at the cursor in any app. Recognition runs offline on the computer with a local model (Qwen3-ASR, SenseVoice, Paraformer), or with the free built-in service or a cloud provider the user chooses; optional AI polish tidies the wording. Licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later.

- Source code: https://github.com/sunerpy/voltip
- Releases and downloads: https://github.com/sunerpy/voltip/releases
- The website is in English at https://voltip.firlab.app/ and in Simplified Chinese at https://voltip.firlab.app/zh/

## Getting started

- [What is Voltip](https://voltip.firlab.app/guide/what-is-voltip): how a dictation works, from the shortcut to the cursor
- [Compared with other apps](https://voltip.firlab.app/guide/compare): Voltip, Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, Typeless, Handy, OpenWhispr and VoiceInk on platforms, on-device recognition, source code and price
- [Install](https://voltip.firlab.app/guide/install): packages and one-line installers for each system
- [Quick start](https://voltip.firlab.app/guide/quick-start): the first dictation
- [Try it online](https://voltip.firlab.app/guide/try): recognition and AI polish in the browser
